open_findings.title: Malformed standard metadata header values bypass HeaderMismatch validation

requirements.requirement: Header failures are HTTP400/-32020; access/header/body checks precede handler admission.
Validate required standard metadata headers against the body; preserve exact malformed/header status grammar.

normative_source.requirement: Header values use visibleASCII/space/HTAB; malformed required headers and invalid-character validation failures require HTTP400 JSON-RPC -32020. Base64 is permitted for Mcp-Name/Mcp-Param, not Method/Version.

open_findings.observation: With matching header/body values, Mcp-Method containing U+0001, DEL or literal UTF8 Unicode returns404/-32601; MCP-Protocol-Version returns400/-32022. Six independently authored ASGI cases fail. Literal UTF8 Unicode reproduces over the real named Friday subprocess on verified privateTLS in BOTH JSON/SSE modes, with0 handler starts, final active0 and child exit0. h11 rejects raw control/DEL bytes before ASGI with400/plaintext; that parser behavior is recorded separately and is not claimed as a new application finding.
open_findings.cause: HTTPServerPolicy.validate checks only CR/LF/NUL and duplicates for mirrored values. validate_rpc_headers compares Method/Version raw bytes without complete character validation, unlike decode_header for Name/custom parameters. Matching malformed bytes therefore pass the header gate and reach method/version routing.
open_findings.risk: The application violates its dated header/error contract and lets malformed mirrored standard values reach RPC routing. No authorization bypass, mutating replay or handler invocation is demonstrated.
open_findings.required_mitigation: Within the existing bounded HTTP policy path, validate standard Method/Version metadata values for the required character/value grammar before RPC routing and return fixed400/-32020 for malformed recognized metadata. Retain separate Host/Origin/Bearer/TLS access handling, byte bounds, duplicate rejection, exact Name/custom Base64 rules and privacy. No accepted client, checker, dependency or other product-path change.
required_tests: Matching Method/Version values with control,DEL and raw nonASCII ASGI cases: exact400/-32020 and0 handlers; positive valid ASCII and case rules.
Actual private verifiedTLS JSON/SSE raw nonASCII negatives bypass SDK retry; zero handler counters, owner/child settlement.
Retain valid unsupported ASCII version400/-32022 supported/requested and unknown ASCII method404/-32601, standard/custom duplicate/CRLFNUL and access-specific status/privacy regressions.
Rerun unchanged full20 profile plus exact diagnostic/skip/warning/dependency integrity and a fresh separate delta/full review.
open_findings.documentation_configuration_impact: Guide18 exact HeaderMismatch claim must match all required standard metadata values. No configuration/default/metadata/optional-role change.
open_findings.remediation_role: Separate remediator required for HTTP security-boundary correction; this report grants no implementation or publication authority.
